text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-000987: billing.ingest.consumer lag > 15m; downstream token counts stale; potential invoice risk 

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: page routed to oncall-sre -> @maria, paging policy: billing-ingest-critical

maria: oncall here, looking. hitting metrics dashboard now — seeing consumer backlog spike on partition-3 and partition-7 :eyes:

aj: +1 im awake. Maria, if you need me for a restart or scale-up I can do it. Any affected customers yet?

sophia: CS note: a couple of billing flows reported delayed charges earlier (ticket #1428) — unsure if same root cause.

maria: Logs show repeated kafka commit timeouts and a flurry of rebalances around 01:12 UTC. consumer group billing-ingest-consumers has 120k messages lag on partition-3.

kevin: Command I'm going to try in a min: bump consumer replicas to 6 for billing-ingest-deploy (currently 3). Will monitor offsets.

maria: hold on scaling, first try graceful restart of the consumer processes on node set b. Rolling restart to avoid more rebalances.

aj: ack. Running rolling restart script now:
```bash
./ops/restart-billing-consumers --group billing-ingest-consumers --subset nodeset-b --rolling 1m
```

maria: seeing restart progress. Node b03 restart completed, rejoin successful, lag reduced from 120k -> 68k on partition-3. Good signal.

sophia: tagging impacted customers list from support: custA, custB, custC. They're on monthly billing; recommend proactive heads-up if we estimate >4hr delay.

maria: still some hot partitions. Offsets show one consumer stuck on a spike of large messages causing long processing time (likely a malformed payload). Extracting sample.

aj: paste sample when you have it. I can run the consumer in debug locally to repro.

maria: sample log: 
```
2026-03-14T01:09:12Z ERROR processing message id=abc123 size=12MB timeout after 30s, stack=...
```

kevin: That 12MB payload is crazy. We should enforce a max-message-size or skip that message and move offset forward to reduce backlog.

maria: agree. Plan: 1) temporarily skip the offending offset on partition-3 to get throughput back 2) increase consumer replica count to handle catch-up 3) add alert to detect oversized messages and drop into quarantine topic.

aj: skipping offset now (manual offset advance). Command:
```bash
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.redwood.svc:9092 --group billing-ingest-consumers --reset-offsets --to-offset 3456789 --topic billing.events --execute
```

aj: offset advance succeeded. partition-3 lag down to 9k. throughput increasing.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-000987 acknowledged by maria at 01:25 UTC

maria: marking this as mitigation in progress. Will keep PD open until consumer backlog < 1k and token counts rehydrate.

sophia: ops — what's ETA for invoice-safe state? Finance needs a conservative estimate to avoid invoice gaps.

maria: rough ETA 90 minutes to clear majority, but backfill/backpressure could make it 2-3 hours for full reconciliation. I'll update if things change.

kevin: I've queued a background backfill job to reprocess quarantined messages once we have stable consumers. Job id bf-20260314-01.

cs-lead: Good. I'll prepare messages for affected customers and hold on the invoice batch release until token reconciliation confirms counts. Please ping when we can safely release.

aj: monitoring graphs: consumer throughput back to ~85% baseline; error rate falling. No new rebalances in the last 8m.

maria: running light health check across consumers and storage: kv-store latency normal, S3 writes healthy. Looks like the single large message was the proximate cause.

pagerduty-bot: PD-000987 status: acknowledged -> assigned to maria; escalation paused.

maria: I'm going to leave an automated mitigation: add consumer filter for >5MB messages to redirect to billing.quarantine. Then schedule a follow-up ticket for ingestion validation.

kevin: config PR ready: 
```yaml
billing_consumer:
  max_message_bytes: 5242880
  quarantine_topic: billing.quarantine
```
Opening canary rollout to 10% of consumers now.

aj: canary looks stable. No regressions seen for 12m on canary subset. Rollout to 100% in 5m.

sophia: update to CS: we expect most customers to see delayed usage reflection up to 3 hours; invoices held until reconciliation completes. We'll send targeted notices to custA/custB.

maria: backlog hit target <1k at 01:58 UTC. Kicking off verification: token counts reconciliation vs ledger snapshot.

aj: reconciliation job running: progress 40% after 10m. 

cs-lead: finance confirmed manual hold on invoice run until you give green. Good call.

maria: reconciliation complete at 02:18 UTC. token counts within 0.15% of expected for high-priority customers. No invoice drift detected beyond threshold.

maria: PD-000987: mitigation complete, consumer group healthy, filters in place, backfill job scheduled, monitoring alerts tuned. Closing the pager shortly. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: PD-000987 status: resolved by maria at 02:19 UTC

aj: moving to post-incident: create follow-up ticket to harden ingestion (message size hard limit, better dead-letter handling, improve metrics to detect single-message stalls). I'll add runbook steps for manual offset skip.

kevin: I'll own the quarantine consumer and implement safe backfill logic.

cs-lead: I'll coordinate customer comms summary and post-mortem with timelines.

maria: thanks all. tagging incident postmortem task: PM-3459. If no objections I'll transition to next oncall at 09:00.

aj: ack handoff. Great work team.

incident-bot: Note: next oncall handoff scheduled @09:00 UTC. Thread closed for live activity, follow-ups moved to #incidents-postmortems and PM-3459.
